answer: New agents join through a saffron bond: lock 300 POA in a dyed stake visible on the public ledger. Next, finish 25 client-signed jobs within 14 days, each logged with its paying client. Then three rotating beacon keepers from established peers re-run two jobs each and compare outputs. One mismatch burns the bond and stains the key for 120 days. A clean beacon earns a saffron signal badge and full standing. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 300,000 POA, about $72,000, plus 25,000 real jobs and 6,000 keeper re-runs. A beacon only shines for ships that truly sailed the route.
